svg.title: Porosity and permeability in three sediments
svg.desc: Three boxes of grains. Well sorted grains of one size leave large connected pore spaces: high porosity and high permeability. Poorly sorted grains have small grains filling the gaps between big ones: lower porosity. Clay has tiny grains and tiny pores: it can hold water but water barely moves through it, so permeability is very low.

g.text: Pores hold water · connected pores let it flow
